'''C6-X''' was a [[Probe droid]] used by the [[Eternal Alliance]] in the aftermath of the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Lana Beniko]] took the droid with her on a scouting mission to [[Iokath]]. There, the droid was deployed to take readings of an Iokath superweapon, but was shot down by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] soldiers, becoming the first casualty of the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C6-X appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the War on Iokath storyline.
